mechanism: Both agents may inhibit CYP3A4 and CYP2D6, potentially increasing cyclobenzaprine levels and CNS depression risk; berberine may also potentiate the sedative effects of cyclobenzaprine.
action: Monitor for enhanced CNS depression (dizziness, sedation, impaired cognition) and consider dose adjustment of cyclobenzaprine if combined; counsel on avoiding alcohol and hazardous activities.
